tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]

Perfect timin', kid! Got a wee favor
to ask ya...

Y'see, I might not look it, but I'm actually
a big fan of traditional Japanese comedy,
rakugo. Even collect books about it.

And there's this rakugo book I wanna get at
<color=#FF423F>Hinokuniya Bookstore</color>...

...but last time I was there, I kinda scared
the staff and they called the cops on me,
so now it's a bit hard for me to go in.

So I was wonderin' if you wouldn't mind
buyin' the book for me.

Course, I ain't askin' ya to do it for nothin'.
I'll pay ya for your trouble.

So whaddaya say? Think you could help me
out here?
Leave it to me.|Piece of cake.
I knew I could count on ya, kid! Means a lot.

The book's called <color=#FF423F>Rakugo and You</color>. Make sure
you get the right one!
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
Ooh, you got the book?
Ah, thanks, kid! I really owe ya one.
This book's actually outta print, y'know?

I've been lookin' all over for it, but that
store's the only place I've seen it.
Never guessed you'd be into rakugo.|You really love rakugo that much?

What? Don't think I'd be the type? Well,
I s'pose my Pop-Pops was into it originally.

I guess his passion for it kinda rubbed off
on me, and I got into it, too.

But my memory's terrible, and I'm always
forgettin' the punchlines.
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]

For example, there's this one joke about a
fish seller...

...and this fish seller's a real lousy dude.
Always gettin' hammered an' screwin' up
at work the next day.

One day, he finds this wallet on the ground,
an' when he opens it up, it's fulla cash.

And this fish seller's over the moon,
thinkin' he's rich! He races home and
celebrates by drinkin' himself silly.

But when he wakes up the next morning, his
wife says to him...

"Wallet? I don't see any wallet. You must've
dreamt it in another one of your drunken
stupors!"
So then what happens?|What does the fish seller do?

Well, the fish seller realizes how foolish
he was, quits booze right then an' there,
and swears to take his job seriously.

...Pretty sure there's somethin' that comes
after that, but I can't remember it for the
life of me...

...But anyway, the gist of it is that the
fish seller ends up changin' his ways.

Hmm, that's really buggin' me now... How'd
the rest of that dang skit go...?

...Oh, my bad! I nearly forgot to thank ya
for buyin' me the book. Appreciate it, kid.

An' if ya happen to come across any other
rakugo books, you reckon you could pick 'em up
for me?
You got it.|I'll keep an eye out.

That's what I like to hear! I knew I could
count on ya, kid!

I reckon <color=#FF423F>Taiheido Bookstore in Shibuya</color>
probably has more of the books I'm lookin'
for...

...but, I mean if I rocked up to Shibuya in
this getup, the cops would be breathin' down
my neck as soon as I left the station!

Jus' 'cause a guy happens to like wearin'
a suit and slickin' back his hair, that
don' mean he's a goddamn yakuza!

I should swing by <color=#FF423F>Taiheido
Bookstore in Shibuya</color> when I
get a chance...
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
Heya, kid. What brings you here?
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]

Wow, you really went an' picked this up for
me? Thanks, kid.

I hate to tell ya this now after you went to
all that trouble, but I'm afraid I don't have
the time to read books no more...
Why the sudden change?|Did something happen?
I've, uhh, kinda wound up in a bit o' debt...

I was out drinking, and lost somethin' that
an old buddy of mine asked me to look after
for 'im.

Somethin' that happened to have a pretty
hefty price tag...

I've searched high an' low for it, but I
can't find it anywhere, so I've gotta pay 'im
back.
What was the item exactly?|Can you describe it?

I dunno, I didn't get a good look at what was
inside, so I got no clue what it was.

But it was my fault for losin' it, so
naturally I've gotta take responsibility for
that and pay my ol' pal back.

That's why I've gotta get me a job and make
some serious cash...

...but, well, there ain't exactly too many
places that'd be willin' to hire a guy like
me, so my options are pretty limited.
So you're looking for work, huh?|Want me to help you find a job?

Hm? You wouldn't happen to know of any
places, would ya? If ya got any leads, I'm
all ears!

I can't say I've got the brains, but I got
brawn in spades!

What else...? Oh yeah, my grandparents
worked on a fishing boat. I used to help 'em
out when I was younger.

So I s'pose I got some fishin' know-how,
too... How to catch 'em and deal with 'em
afterwards, that sorta thing...

Somethin' along those lines would be great,
but where the heck would those kinda skills
come in handy?

Hmm... Maybe it'd be worth
inquiring at the <color=#FF423F>fishing pond
in Ichigaya</color>...

What's that? Are we hiring? As a matter of
fact, yeah, we just had a part-time position
open up...
tnxotb-[Dialog_content_3907273]

We welcome anyone who's got experience in
fishing with open arms!

Pay's not too bad, either. It's all up to how
many shifts you can take.

Maybe this job would be
a good fit for Shishida...

Huh... So you're sayin' there's a part-time
position open at the fishing pond in
Ichigaya?
Well, damn! That sounds like the perfect fit!

Thanks for helpin' me out here, kid! Means
a lot.

It'll probably take me a while to pay off
my debt, but I'll just keep chippin' away
at it as best I can.

I hope Shishida will be able
to pay his debt off soon...

Next time I get a chance,
I should check in on Shishida
and see how he's doing...

Hey, boss. Did you hear that Shishida's got
a job at the fishing pond?

Sure did. That chump's gotta work hard to
pay back those fat stacks he owes me.

But all that was really inside was some cheap
canned food, right?

Hahaha! For all he knows, he lost a national
treasure! That dumbass'll didn't even
question that bullshit I fed him.

It's safe to say we won't be hurtin' for cash
for the next wee while.

Boy, you sure found one gullible suckers,
boss!

Heh, you got that right. If I'd known he was
that gullible, I'd've pulled this on him ages
ago!

But what will you do if Shishida finds out
you tricked him?

That ain't gonna be a problem. After all,
I got the contract I made him sign riiight
here.

You're a genius, boss! You really thought
this whole thing through!

Seems like Shishida's been
tricked by that man...
I have to tell him right away.

Hey, thanks again for helpin' me land that
job! Things have been goin' great!

I actually just wrapped up a shift at another
gig, and stopped here to chill for a bit.

I might not have much time to myself these
days, but y'know what? Workin' hard ain't
half bad...

Oh yeah, so what was it you wanted to
tell me?

I need to tell Shishida that
he's being scammed...
Truth is...|I overheard two guys talking...
Hm? Well, c'mon, don't leave me hangin' here.

...You're sayin' my ol' buddy pulled one over
on me? You can't expect me to believe that,
can you?

Then again... I s'pose you ain't really the
jokin' type, are ya, kid...?
I'm serious.|You have to believe me.
...All right, I believe ya, kid.

Thing is, though, I signed a contract,
promisin' that I'd pay 'im back.

And, well... contracts are legally bindin'
an' all that...

There's gotta be something
I can do to help Shishida...
So who is this buddy of yours?|Can you tell me who he is?

Hmm? His name's <color=#FF423F>Tadao Kashima</color>. I used to
work with him.
What kinda work?|It wasn't dirty work, was it...?

We both used to work in a crêpe food truck.
I dunno the first thing about bakin', so I'd
handle all the other tasks...

But, well, that business didn't end up
lastin' too long. Kashima told me he's
involved in financial work now.

Man, you think you know a guy, and then
all these years later, they go an' pull
somethin' like this...?

...I think I'm gonna go have a li'l chat
with Kashima tomorrow!

Thanks for bringin' this all to my attention,
kid. Seriously appreciate it.

It seems like Shishida is
planning to confront Kashima...

I sure hope their chat
doesn't turn ugly...

I'll wait here for Shishida
to show up...
Kashima, you asshole!

I know that "precious item" of yours was just
some canned food! You lying son of a bitch!

Shishida... If I ain't mistaken, I seem to
recall you signing a contract.

And that contract never specified what the
item was! Just that you owe me 1,000,000 yen
if you lose it!

You got that? Doesn't matter if it was canned
food or the Mona Lisa. A deal's a deal!

So how's it feel, Shishida? Pretty good life
lesson for ya, huh? You can think of that
mil as your tuition fee.

How could you betray me like this without
the slightest sense of guilt...? You an' I
go way back!

That's right. You're like a brother to me...
but even brothers have to pay back what
they owe.

Kashima...! When the hell'd you become such
a backstabbin' bastard!?

What happened to my ol' buddy at the food
truck, who used to bake crêpes with a grin!?

Don't gimme that crap! You were always
getting in my goddamn way! You couldn't bake
a crêpe to save your life!

I noticed it way back then... You're a hard
worker, but a gullible fool.

That's when I realized, I'd make way more
cash tricking suckers like you than baking
crêpes!

You schemin' scumbag... I'll make you regret
what you've done!
Oh, yeah? I'd like to see you try!
Shishida! Kashima! Hold it right there!
Crap, not those cops again...!

Kashima... Am I right in understanding that
you've caught your friend here in a scam?

No, sir! This guy lost something very
precious to me, an—
Give it up. We heard the whole thing.

Kashima... We've been following you on
suspicions of illegal money lending and
extortion.

And now we finally have the proof to take
you in. You're coming with us.
Huh? I dunno what you're talking about!You've got the wrong guy!
Tadao Kashima, you're under arrest.
...God dammit!

You need to be more careful, Shishida. If
you'd started a fight, we would've had to
arrest you, too.

You guys sure did turn up at the perfect
time... Were you guys tailin' Kashima or
somethin'?

No. We received an anonymous tip that two
guys looked like they were about to get
into a fight.
An anonymous tip...? How about that...

You were one of his scam victims, weren't
you, Shishida? Would you mind explaining
everything to us at the station?

I had a feelin' you'd ask that... Man, I got
work soon...

I wonder what happened
to Shishida. If I have time,
I should see how he's doing.
Looks like you've helped me out once again...
Thanks, kid... I owe you big time.
What're you talking about?|I didn't do anything...

Hah, don't think you can pull the wool over
my eyes, kid. I know it was you.

Whenever I have to talk to the cops, they
usually grill me on every dang word that
comes outta my mouth...

...but because you'd called the cops for me,
everythin' went surprisingly smoothly.

They even made that backstabbin' jerk
Kashima reimburse everythin' I'd paid him
up till now.

...Heh, everythin' resolved itself so neatly,
I almost wanna laugh. Feels like I'm in a
rakugo skit.
Guess you can quit your job now.|No more need to overwork yourself!
Yep... You're right...

...but I think I'm gonna keep workin' that
gig at the fishin' pond you introduced me to,
kid.

...You remember that one rakugo joke I was
tellin' ya about before?

The one where the drunken fish seller found
a wallet fulla cash, but his wife told him
he must've dreamt it...?
I actually managed to remember how it ended.

Turns out the wallet was real after all,
but his wife turned it in to the authorities
without tellin' him.

But because she did that, the fish seller
became an honest worker...

...so when he found out the truth, he wasn't
angry one bit. In fact, he was grateful!

...'cept it wasn't my lovin' wife who hid the

...After I quit my crêpe truck job, I never

But after all this, I feel like I came to

An' that's when I realized, dang, rakugo

It ain't just about makin' ya laugh. It even

Woof! Woof! Hooray! Nice weather, huh? It's
another perfect day here in Shibuya!

And you're here in Shibuya on this perfect
day! I can tell you must really love Shibuya,
don't ya?
Of course!|I heart Shibuya!

Good answer! I can tell you're a true

Now then, looks like it's time for...
Shichi-kun's surprise Shibuya Quiz!

Get it right, and you'll win a special prize
from me, Shichi-kun!
I accept your challenge!|I'll get that prize!

Naturally, this quiz is all about our lovely
city of Shibuya!

For a true lover of Shibuya such as yourself,
this should be a cinch!
Ready?
Bring it!|All set!

Right then, question one! Our first category
is "local shopping"!

There's a ton of stores in the underground
mall. You can find all sorts of amazing
things for sale there!

Now, suppose your friend from abroad is
visiting and you want to get them the perfect
gift that just screams "Japan"...
Which store are you gonna head to?
The flower shop.|The souvenir shop.|The cosmetic store.
Oooh, sorry, that's wrong!

Maybe you should take a closer look next
time you visit the underground mall.

But, that's just the first question out
of three!
Don't lose hope now!

That's exactly right! I can feel the
Shibuya love!

Second question is coming in hot, so let's
keep it up!
Show me your true passion for Shibuya!
You got it!|I heart Shibuya!

Question two! This time we're headed over
to Central Street!

Shopping in Central Street is so much fun,
but there's almost too many delicious things
to eat!

Now tell me, do you know the name of the
burger restaurant on Central Street?
Bye-Bye Burger.|Boom Bang Burger.|Big Dog Burger.
Ah, too bad! That's incorrect.

But sometimes even I forget the name of a
restaurant as soon as I walk through the door!

You've still got the third question left to
go, so don't let it get you down!

That's exactly right! I can feel the
Shibuya love!
Hehe, that brings us to our third question!
Last one! You've got this!
Leave it to me!|Woof! Woof! Hooray!

Question three! This time, we're looking at
the Station Square!

The square in front of Shibuya Station is a
pretty famous meeting spot, you know?

You've probably made plans to meet your pals
here too a few times, I'm sure...

So... When you're meeting people at Station
Square, what kind of animal is the statue
right in the center?
A dog.|A cat.|A monkey.

That's exactly right! I can feel the
Shibuya love!

Whoops, too bad. That's not right. Maybe
you're just more of a cat person?

Next time you're at the Station Square,
take a closer look!
Too bad, that's incorrect!

But, if we did have a monkey here in front
of Shibuya Station...
That would be pretty fun, huh?

Okay, that's all of my questions! You did
a great job!

And your final score is... 100%! You've got
some serious Shibuya love, I can tell.

I could tell you're a true Shibuya devotee!
I'm so happy... *sniff* It brings a tear
to my eye...
I'm happy too.|Let's see a smile.

Seeing someone who loves Shibuya just as
much as I do... Ah, this is what I live for!

All right, for getting every single question
right, you've earned a reward! Here, you
deserve this!

I hope you'll continue to spread the love
for Shibuya!
Until next time, then! Woof! Woof! Hooray!

waiting for you.
Come back next time and aim for the top!
I'll get it next time!|I must hone my love for Shibuya...

Yeah, yeah, that's the spirit! We've gotta
love Shibuya more and more!
Until then! Woof! Woof! Hooray!
